# LevelHubAI - olevel.com.pk

## About
LevelHubAI is Pakistan's leading gamified O-Level exam preparation platform. It helps students prepare for Cambridge O-Level (and IGCSE) examinations through interactive video lessons, AI-powered quizzes, practice questions, past papers, and a gamification system with XP, streaks, badges, and leaderboards.

## URL
https://olevel.com.pk

## Subjects Offered
- Mathematics (IGCSE 0580 / O Level 4024)
- Physics (IGCSE 0625 / O Level 5054)
- Chemistry (IGCSE 0620 / O Level 5070)
- Biology (IGCSE 0610 / O Level 5090)
- ICT (IGCSE 0478 / O Level 2210)
- English Language
- Pakistan Studies
- Islamiyat
- Urdu
- Accounting

## Key Features
- Gamified learning with XP points, levels, streaks, and badges
- Video lessons aligned to Cambridge CIE curriculum
- AI-powered quizzes and practice questions
- Past paper practice with marking scheme analysis
- AI Tutor for personalized help
- School challenges and leaderboards
- Daily missions and goals
- Weekly progress reports

## Target Audience
- O-Level students in Pakistan (ages 14-18)
- Cambridge International Education (CIE) students worldwide
- Students preparing for IGCSE examinations

## Pricing
- Free Plan: Access to select subjects (Mathematics, ICT)
- Pro Plan: All subjects, AI tutoring, advanced features
